cultural_heritage_history_00069.name: Lest we forget
cultural_heritage_history_00069.author: Loïc Norgeot
cultural_heritage_history_00069.description:
**"Paix et Liberté ne sont jamais acquises"**

![](https://i.imgur.com/x4iIJAq.jpg)

This commemorative stela, located in [Santec](https://goo.gl/maps/4e7ppJfuPiQ2) (France), was raised in honor of the 128 sailors who lost ther life aboard the [HMCS Athabaskan](https://goo.gl/Z6CzRc) in the night of April 19th, 1944.

The Athabaskan was a canadian destroyer which was sunk by the [German torpedo boat T24](https://goo.gl/5ESxwy) during an interception mission in the English Channel, and now lies at 90m depth.

If you are curious about the fate of this ship, you'll find more interesting information [here](https://goo.gl/y6TynL) and [there](https://goo.gl/6P1D1v).

The scan was created from 96 pictures taken with a Canon Eos-1100D, processed with Colmap and OpenMVS, and re-textured and optimized to a lower resolution (~15k triangles) with Blender and [BakeMyScan](http://bakemyscan.org).

![](https://i.imgur.com/wz8oKE4.jpg)

cultural_heritage_history_00155.name: Historically Accurate Fauchard
cultural_heritage_history_00155.author: andreigabriel29
cultural_heritage_history_00155.description:
This Fauchard has a large head of high carbon steel which is durably mounted onto a robust haft of smooth-polished hardwood. Dual screw at the base of the socket reinforce and secure the head of this polearm to its mounting.

This glaive-like Fauchard has a hook-like extension on the blade that would have been ideal for pushing or pulling cavalrymen off their mount. The sweeping, cleaver-like blade is perfect for delivering very powerful cuts and chops and its sharply tapered blade point is a surprisingly capable piercing tool. Parrying hooks give a skilled bearer the ability to stop and turn aside strikes from other weapons and prevent them from skipping down the haft to strike the bearers hands and arms after an entanglement in a melee.

science_technology_00214.author: ЭЛЕКТРОЛУЧ
science_technology_00214.description: Explosion-proof LED luminaires EL-Line-Ex with explosion protection marking 1Ex mb IIC T6 X are designed to illuminate explosive zones of classes 1 and 2 indoors and outdoors in accordance with GOST IEC 60079-10-1-20011. The luminaire consists of an aluminum housing in which an LED module is mounted, covered with a protective glass made of optical polycarbonate, and a mounting unit. The LED module uses the latest generation of ultra-bright LEDs. Various types of fastenings: bar (UC), swivel bracket (SB), wire suspension (HM), cantilever suspension (SM) will help you to install the luminaire on the wall or ceiling correctly and conveniently. With the help of explosion-proof luminaires of the EL-Line-Ex series, explosion-proof modular lighting systems with a power of up to 240 W can be created.
